dogecoin.text: $500 invested in dogecoin in June is worth $150,000 right now and please believe me we are headed for absolute financial catastrophe.

@GarantizaAK Crypto, while here to stay, is still tulips deep down. The fact that dogecoin has no inflation protection and the supply can be added anytime makes this speculation *bonkers* and I don't know what's gonna shake it loose: catastrophe or regulation, but something will.
